slides.title: JPMorgan and MP Materials
slides.note: A replaceable bank commitment, an equity takeout and government-linked corporate credit
slides.author: Benjamin Yang

slides.title: Equity secured cash while MP retained exposure through commissioning
slides.scope: Analyst judgment · comparable industrial sponsor and lender perspective
slides.note: Assess funding through commissioning using dated cash availability, permitted uses and corporate covenant tests.
findings: Net common-equity proceeds received in July 2025, with 7.68% isolated ownership dilution
Remaining conditional revolver capacity at September 2026, after letters of credit
Defense agreements enter the EBITDA definition and a performance covenant. Actual addback use remains unknown
slides.caveat: The evidence supports financing flexibility. Original loan terms and a remaining-cost schedule are insufficient to rank the capital mix or certify completion funding.

slides.title: Replacement rights connected the closing commitment to later financing
slides.scope: Documented sequence · 2025 · amounts have different financing statuses
slides.note: The commitment served a closing and contingent-funding function. MP reports that replacement financing reduced it until it expired undrawn.
rows: Government agreements and replaceable joint commitment of at least $1bn
Common-equity pricing at $55. July completion ultimately supplied $724.2m net
Corporate revolving credit facility executed for $275m
slides.caveat: Apple announced a separate agreement on 15 July, before equity pricing. The sequence alone cannot isolate its influence or that of government support.

slides.title: JPMorgan spans the financing stages alongside substantial partner roles
slides.scope: Documented functions · legal entities and initial underwriting obligations
slides.note: JPMorgan’s continuing agency role connects the financing stages. Goldman shared the original commitment and the same initial equity allocation.
rows: J.P. Morgan: sole financial adviser, per its own account
JPMorgan Chase Funding Inc.: joint commitment
Goldman Sachs Bank USA. Individual holds unknown
J.P. Morgan Securities LLC: ≈40% of initial shares
JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A.: agent, lender and L-C issuer
Joint arrangers Goldman/Morgan Stanley. Citi/BofA roles
slides.caveat: Initial underwriting obligations establish participation, not retained investment, fee allocation or unique capability.

slides.title: An available equity takeout best explains the observed transition
slides.scope: Ranked explanations · overlapping mechanisms, rather than causal percentages
slides.note: The takeout can be conventional while the combined contractual architecture remains useful to a financing team.
rows: Strong: express replacement rights, completed proceeds and issuer-reported lapse
Direct mechanisms in public capital and credit terms. Equity-demand effect unisolated
3. Debt-cost or leverage aversion drove the choice
Plausible. Missing loan pricing, tenor and management rationale prevent confirmation
Weak: completed replacement financing fits the disclosed sequence better
slides.caveat: Apple’s agreement and the available equity market are credible influences. The record does not establish JPMorgan indispensability or financing optimality.

slides.title: Equity supplied $724.2m at 7.68% isolated ownership dilution
slides.scope: SMPT calculation · July-9 basic share base plus the completed offering only
slides.note: Equity avoids scheduled principal and coupon payments while transferring residual ownership. Unknown original loan terms prevent a lifetime financing-cost ranking.
slides.caveat: Excludes preferred conversion, warrants, other issuances, options and convertibles. The 3% underwriting discount is a one-time transaction cost, not the cost of equity.

slides.title: Letters of credit leave $203m of the $275m revolver available
slides.scope: Reported snapshots and SMPT decomposition · USD million · zero loan draws
slides.note: Letters of credit consume facility capacity without supplying construction cash. Future borrowing remains subject to the credit agreement.
slides.caveat: The $200m L-C sublimit sits inside the $275m facility. MP reported compliance at 30 September 2026. This is capacity, separate from cash on hand.

slides.title: Defense contracts enter both covenant earnings and performance obligations
slides.scope: Executed corporate credit agreement · mechanism plus hypothetical USD-million illustration
slides.note: Contractual earnings recognition can precede collection. The certificate calculation and the underlying contract performance both deserve diligence.
rows: Applicable Test-Period minimums / guaranteed revenues / fixed-price amounts less attributable net income, floored at zero
Borrower supplies the estimate. Later cash duplicating a prior addback is subtracted
MP must perform Defense agreements, subject to a Material Adverse Effect exception
Specified representations and absence of Default condition new credit extensions
slides.example: Hypothetical clause arithmetic: max($40m applicable amount − $20m attributable income, 0) = $20m addback
slides.caveat: Actual adjustment use and headroom are unknown. Future 10X amounts require applicable entitlement. No existing default or automatic loss of availability is inferred.

slides.title: Corporate earnings tests can precede expected 10X commissioning
slides.scope: Contractual timing scenario · calendar-year bounds for management’s expectation
slides.note: Treasury and lenders need a corporate earnings and eligible-liquidity case during construction, before assuming 10X operating receipts contribute.
rows: At least $500m unrestricted contractual cash / Cash Equivalents
First quarter ending after delivery: 30 Sep 2027
Leverage ≤4.00× and cash-interest coverage ≥3.00×, subject to terms
10X begins commissioning. Commissioning is distinct from contractual COD
slides.caveat: An earlier ≥$400m EBITDA certificate can trigger the switch. Delivery timing is assumed, not a legal deadline. The 93–458 days compare year endpoints, not forecast COD dates.

slides.title: Government support covers specified exposures while MP retains funding duties
slides.scope: Contract and reported cash distinctions · each instrument assessed separately
slides.note: MP must use reasonable best efforts to raise additional capital if enumerated funding is insufficient. Timing obligations are qualified, and the parent guarantee runs to DoD.
rows: Designation, quantity, costs and collection timing
Conditional purchase mechanics. July equity exceeded threshold
slides.caveat: Specified source/use restrictions constrain flexibility. The separate $150m samarium loan is repayable and serves another project. No extra backstop cash is counted.

slides.title: 10X threshold protection changes with contractual operating status
slides.scope: Hypothetical full-year CY2029 threshold definition · USD million · 50% capacity illustration
slides.note: Before the production milestone, capacity scales the threshold. From that milestone, the full escalating definition applies. These states change the entitlement used in a financing assessment.
slides.caveat: The legal term starts at signing and runs to ten years after COD. Full-year amounts exclude first-payment stub and annual true-up. Threshold EBITDA is distinct from cash available for debt service and corporate covenant EBITDA.

slides.title: Price protection delivered $110.9m of cash during nine-month 2026
slides.scope: Reported receipts and SMPT receivable reconciliation · USD million
slides.note: Payment evidence matters independently of accounting income, receivables and award ceilings. Reported receipts are already included in operating cash flow.
slides.equation_labels: Opening PPA receivable + nine-month income − closing receivable = implied receipts
slides.caveat: The $110.869m rollforward is consistent with reported rounded receipts of $110.9m. The distinct $6.5m HREE construction-award cash belongs in the company liquidity bridge.

slides.title: Company liquid assets fell $492.4m as expansion continued
slides.scope: Historical cash plus short-term investments · USD million · nine months to 30 Sep 2026
slides.note: The bridge demonstrates continued corporate resource use across multiple projects. A remaining 10X funding requirement needs a separate cost-to-complete and collection schedule.
slides.caveat: All seven components reconcile at unrounded precision. PPA receipts are inside operating cash flow. Company liquid assets are not free 10X cash or certified covenant liquidity.

slides.title: A dated funding and covenant schedule is the next decision input
slides.scope: Analyst recommendations · comparable sponsor is primary audience
slides.model_ref: analysis.md: decisions and conditions through commissioning
slides.note: The record supports the financing architecture and a diligence sequence. Missing loan terms leave the optimal capital mix open.
rows: Confirm settled proceeds, permitted uses and live credit conditions before cancellation. Unfunded replacement requires another committed route
Fund through commissioning / CFO and lenders
Reconcile cash, L-Cs, spend, collections and certificates by date. A projected shortfall calls for earlier financing, revised spend or amendment
Test entitlement and performance separately from EBITDA recognition. Delayed collection or a material contract issue requires reassessment
slides.caveat: DoD has contractual cost-to-complete and funding-information rights. Those reports are absent from the public packet. No actual shortfall or automatic default is asserted.

slides.title: Evidence supports the architecture and bounds the financial conclusions
slides.scope: Research cutoff: 6 November 2026 · model 1.0 · agent-assisted independent SMPT analysis
slides.note: The model separates facts, calculations and scenarios. Human financial and publication review remains pending.
rows: No debt-versus-equity optimality or exact $0.8m cancellation reconciliation
No demonstrated addback use or actual headroom
No completion-funding certification, runway or project debt-service forecast
Bank individual holds and internal decisions
No bank profitability, sole-design or indispensability claim
